messages.author: Rana Rehan Khalid
messages.body:
Dear Amber User
I am working on ZN mediated interactions system that are as follow
ZN ion interacts with ---------2 aspartic acids,
ZN                      ----------O atom of Ligand
ZN                      ---------- with histidine.
ZN                     ------------F atom of ligand
I have prepared the smaller and larger model  by using
MCPB.py -i 1OKL.in -s 1
This generates a smaller and larger model, I am confused that why the
smaller model showed a bond between ASP and histidine rather than ZN
mediation. Please guide me in this regard. I am attaching the published
interaction system image and my MCPB generated small system images.
Thank you so much.
Best
Rehan
